CheckTitle: Ensure Fusion ERP Transactions Allowed by SoD Violations Are Monitored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
SubSectionName: Application Business User Separation of Duties (SoD)
RequiredAccess: Fusion Applications Security Console / Audit Reports (IT Security Manager)
Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management (Advanced Controls)
Description: ERP transactions completed by the same user on both sides of an SoD conflict should be monitored.
Risk: These transactions are where SoD conflicts turn into losses.
AuditProcedure: Review the transactions in Reports and Analytics.
Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Examples: 40001-40017.

Steps: Reverse the transaction where possible and fix the configuration that allowed it.
